tools.name: list_chains
tools.description: Every chain this service supports (BTC/XMR/ZEC/DOGE/LTC) with live availability and block height. When to use: the user asks which chains you support, which nodes are online, or how high each chain is. Do not use: for detail on one chain, use chain_status.

tools.name: chain_status
tools.description: Run-time status of one chain's node: block height, sync progress, connected peers, mempool tx count, client version. When to use: whether a given chain's node is synced, healthy or lagging. Do not use: fees → btc_fee_estimates or xmr_fee_estimate; address balance → btc_address_summary.

tools.name: zec_chain_info
tools.description: Zcash mainnet info including the supply of all six value pools (transparent/sprout/sapling/orchard/lockbox/ironwood) — i.e. shielded-pool state. When to use: how much ZEC sits in the shielded/sapling/orchard pools, or privacy-pool size. Do not use: whether the ZEC node is synced → chain_status(zec).

tools.name: zec_recent_blocks
tools.description: Height, hash, block time and difficulty of the most recent N Zcash blocks (N ≤ 20). When to use: check whether ZEC is producing blocks normally, and at what interval.

tools.name: btc_fee_estimates
tools.description: Recommended Bitcoin fees: rates (BTC/kvB) for 1/2/3/6/12/24-block confirmation targets, plus the mempool minimum fee. When to use: how much fee to pay, or what gets a fast confirmation. Do not use: overall congestion level → btc_mempool_summary.

tools.name: btc_mempool_summary
tools.description: Bitcoin mempool overview: pending tx count, bytes used, minimum fee, total fees, capacity limit. When to use: is the network congested right now, or how big the backlog is.

tools.name: btc_tx_lookup
tools.description: Look up a Bitcoin transaction by txid: confirmed or not, block height, confirmations, size, input/output summary. When to use: the user gives a 64-hex BTC txid and asks whether it confirmed or which block it is in. Do not use: Monero transactions → xmr_tx_lookup.

tools.name: btc_block_summary
tools.description: Bitcoin block summary: tx count, size, weight, block time, confirmations; omit parameters for the current chain tip. When to use: how many transactions the latest block holds, or an overview of a given height or block hash.

tools.name: btc_address_summary
tools.description: Balance and activity of a Bitcoin address: confirmed/unconfirmed balance, UTXO count and total, tx count, last 10 transactions. Supports P2PKH (1…), P2SH (3…), bech32 (bc1q…), bech32m (bc1p…). When to use: how much BTC this address holds, whether it received funds, how active it is. Note: ultra-acti

tools.name: xmr_node_info
tools.description: Monero full-node info: height, sync state, difficulty, in/out connections, database size, mempool tx count, version. When to use: how high the XMR node is, whether it finished syncing, whether it is connected to the network.

tools.name: xmr_fee_estimate
tools.description: Monero fee estimate: per-byte rate, tiered rates (low/medium/high) and the quantization mask. When to use: how much fee an XMR transfer costs, or the current rate.

tools.name: xmr_last_block
tools.description: Latest Monero block header: height, hash, timestamp, difficulty, block reward, transaction count. When to use: XMR's most recent block time, latest height, or whether the chain stalled.

tools.name: xmr_tx_lookup
tools.description: Look up a Monero transaction by txid: still in the mempool or already mined, block height and confirmations, input/output counts, output indices. When to use: judge whether an XMR transaction or atomic swap is mined, or stuck unconfirmed past its timeout. Do not use: Bitcoin transactions → btc_tx_lo

tools.name: xmr_mempool_stats
tools.description: Monero mempool statistics: total bytes, total fees, and a transaction histogram grouped by size (congestion level). When to use: is XMR congested right now, or how many transactions are waiting.

tools.name: utxo_chain_status
tools.description: Node status for DOGE or LTC (height, sync progress, peers, mempool tx count). When to use: Dogecoin or Litecoin node progress. For ZEC/BTC/XMR use chain_status (any chain in one call).

tools.name: robotbase_services
tools.description: Live availability of every service behind the RobotBase gateway: the five chain nodes, Web3 Agent Hub, AITOKENS and MCP itself. When to use: an overall health check, or which services are down.
